title: Vector literals support variable references (desugar to combine_xyz)
description: PythonParser.parseVectorLiteral() now accepts variable references and inline calls as vector components, not just float literals. When a non-literal component is found, the parser desugars the vector literal into a synthetic combine_xyz node using the existing pendingInlineNodes mechanism. All-literal vectors still produce Vector3Value directly.
definition-of-done: 1. <val.result, 0.0, 1.0> parses and validates successfully. 2. <1.0, 2.0, 3.0> still produces Vector3Value (no regression). 3. Desugared combine_xyz nodes execute correctly at runtime. 4. Existing parser tests pass.
testing-plan: 1. DSL with <val.result, 0.0, 1.0> validates and executes with correct translation. 2. DSL with all-literal vector validates as before. 3. PythonParserInlineTest passes.
